scoring_justification: Recompute from raw artifacts is infeasible (no lightweight DFT module). Compare agent's reported values to paper-reported gold within tolerances; also enforce trend that H* on S,Se,Te is endergonic.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for adsorption energies and electronic properties from the paper's supplementary tables.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Supporting Information Table S4 (adsorption energies) and Table S3 (electronic properties) for Cu(111)-X systems (X=O,S,Se,Te).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct transcription from the paper's supplementary tables.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's actual reported numbers.

schema.description: The top-level object must contain a key 'adsorption_energies' whose value is an array. Each array element is an object with fields: system (string), adsorbate (string, 'H*' or 'CO₂*'), site (string, 'Cu' or 'X'), adsorption_free_energy_eV (number), and activation_angle_deg (number, required only for CO₂* entries). The array must also include chalcogen adsorption free energies using adsorbate 'X_adatom'.

outputs.description: DFT-computed adsorption free energies for H* and CO₂* on clean Cu(111) and atop chalcogen adatoms (O, S, Se, Te), using the computational hydrogen electrode at U=0 V vs RHE and pH 6.7. Provides the activity trend: H* adsorption must be endergonic on S, Se, Te, and CO₂* must show activation with lower free energies relative to clean Cu.

schema.description: An array of objects, each containing: system (string), chalcogen (string, one of 'O','S','Se','Te'), Bader_charge_X_e (number), p_band_center_X_eV (number), d_band_shift_Cu_eV (number).

outputs.description: Electronic descriptors computed from DFT charge density and density-of-states: Bader charge on each chalcogen, p-band center of the chalcogen relative to the Fermi level, and shift in the Cu d-band center relative to clean Cu(111). Explains basicity and reactivity trends.

output_contract.notes: The cation effect stage (experimental partial current density vs solvation free energy) is not included because it requires non-public experimental data. The Pourbaix diagram and XPS shifts are included as process steps for completeness but are not scored; their evidence artifacts are optional. All values compared against paper-reported data from Tables S3–S4 with appropriate tolerances.
